## R Markdown
```{r}
Interaction_Table_long <- read_csv("Coauthor edits/Submission to Environmental Insights Journal/Tracking revisions/Code for revisions/Interaction Table_long.csv")

```


```{r}
Interaction_Table_long=Interaction_Table_long |> filter(Stratification!="Missing") 


Interaction_Table_long$Metabolite=factor(Interaction_Table_long$Metabolite, levels=c( "DMP", "DMTP", "DETP"))

Interaction_Table_long$Outcome=factor(Interaction_Table_long$Outcome, levels=c( "All-cause", "CVD", "Cancer"))


Interaction_Table_long$Stratification=factor(Interaction_Table_long$Stratification, levels=c( "Birth Cohort 1951-2000", "Birth Cohort 1910-1950", "current smoker", "past smoker", "non smoker"))


Interaction_Table_long_plot=Interaction_Table_long |> ggplot(aes(x = HR, y = Stratification, color = as.factor(Quartile))) +
  geom_point(size = 5.5,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = CI_Low, xmax = CI_High),
    width = 0.5,
    linewidth=2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2.5, color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.8)+
  facet_grid(Outcome ~ Metabolite) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Quartile"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 30),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 30),
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 30),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 30),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 30)
)

Interaction_Table_long_plot
```


```{r}
ggsave("Coauthor edits/Submission to Environmental Insights Journal/Tracking revisions/Code for revisions/Interaction Table_long.tiff",
       plot=Interaction_Table_long_plot,
       width=20,
       height=25,
       units="in",
       dpi=600,
  compression = "lzw"
       
)
```
